recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future need for multiple independent computable policy bases in one current Consent resource should be raised as a new work-group issue because the single policyBasis cardinality is a later R5/R6 design decision rather than an unapplied part of FHIR-11058.
issue_request: FHIR-11058 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Consent after the 2016 September ballot. It requested changing Consent.policy from a required single URI to support multiple policies, adding Consent.policyRule as a computable policy URI, and requiring policy and/or policyRule.
initial_application: Commit 612068c15886b6624c44de5d656417bcfa7d76d3 explicitly included GF#11058 in the STU3 Consent updates. It changed Consent.policy from 1..1 uri to 0..* uri, added Consent.policyRule 0..1 uri, updated examples to use policyRule, and added the policy/policyRule invariant.
additional_context: Later final Consent decisions intentionally changed the policy model. FHIR-32817 introduced regulatoryBasis 0..*, policyBasis 0..1 Reference/URI, and policyText 0..* DocumentReference. FHIR-25387 removed the core invariant requiring policy or policyRule while retaining guidance, FHIR-39597 moved default decision semantics to Consent.decision, FHIR-45450 restored policyBasis.uri, and FHIR-55983 updated remaining old-name wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml is an active build input and already has repeatable regulatoryBasis and policyText, a single policyBasis for the computable backing policy, and no active old policy/policyRule invariant. Reintroducing old Consent.policy or changing policyBasis cardinality would override later work-group decisions.

related_jiras.note: R5 decision that replaced old Consent.policy/Consent.policyRule with regulatoryBasis, policyBasis, and policyText.
Removed the core invariant requiring policy or policyRule and preserved non-invariant guidance using current element names.
Moved base decision behavior away from provision zero to Consent.decision.
Restored policyBasis.uri as the URI child for computable policy identifiers.
Updated current R6 Consent wording that still referenced old policy/policyRule names.
